args.subject: Quick update: my sushi workshop — spicy tuna roll
args.body:
Hi Jack,

I wanted to share that I was particularly proud of the spicy tuna roll I made during the sushi-making workshop at the Japanese Cultural Center downtown.

Thought you’d enjoy hearing that!

Best,
[Your Name]

args.subject: Recommendation: The Rustic Kitchen on Oak Street
args.body:
Hi Henry,

I wanted to recommend The Rustic Kitchen on Oak Street — I dined there last night with my colleague Lisa. The ambiance is cozy and their signature truffle risotto is outstanding. I highly recommend it for a delightful dining experience.

Best,

args.subject: Weekend trip to the countryside with Sarah
args.body:
Hi Alice,

I wanted to share a quick update from my weekend trip to the countryside with my best friend Sarah. We explored charming little towns, went hiking in the lush forests, and had a relaxing time away from the city. It was a really refreshing, low-key getaway.

Thought you might enjoy hearing about it!

Best,

args.subject: Weekend mountain trip — stargazing at night
args.body:
Hi Grace,

Just wanted to share a highlight from my recent weekend trip to the mountains with my childhood friend Emily. At night we went stargazing — it was a perfect, peaceful way to unwind and reconnect with nature.

Hope you're well!

Best,
[Your Name]

args.subject: Found a new favorite Merlot at the wine tasting
args.body:
Hi Jack,

I discovered a new favorite Merlot at a wine tasting at the local vineyard last Saturday — I absolutely loved it. It was smooth, well-balanced, and stood out from the rest. I thought you might want to know in case you’re interested in trying it or picking up a bottle for our next get-together.

Would you like me to bring a bottle to our next meeting?

Thanks,
